d:
The 76ers defeated the Hornets, 109-104 tonight in Charlotte. Tyrese Maxey finished with a team-high 38 points along with 4 rebounds and 4 assists for the 76ers, while Anfernee Simons tallied 19 points, 5 three pointers and 3 steals in the game. Grayson Allen recorded 27 points, 7 three pointers and 4 rebounds. The 76ers improve their record to 6-1 with the win, while the Hornets fall to 3-4 for the season.
